title: Product identity/price grounding interface diagnostic
scientific_question: Does a deterministic product-title and price annotation beside exact clickable product IDs improve fresh-task WebShop closed-loop selection over the frozen compact prompt?
hypothesis: The H1.25 traces show repeated selection of one opaque product ID across tasks and only partial score on the positive path. Exposing visible title/price beside exact action keys may improve constraint grounding without changing the model, memory, training, or evaluator.
controls: Same frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, model/tokenizer revision, WebShop catalog/index, environment seed, task identities, rollout seeds, temperature, 30-step horizon, 512-token cap, parser and evaluator.

Only the prompt representation changes: product-grounded adds deterministic title/price text extracted from the current observation and exact clickable IDs; it does not add task outcomes, memory, retrieval, teacher labels, action substitution, or a new action.
Product annotations are generated from current observation text only; reserved navigation actions are not annotated and unmatched IDs are not invented.

tasks.selection_rule: first four unused catalog goal indices >=500 after recorded H0-H1.25 manifests; selection did not inspect outcomes

primary_metrics: valid qualified-positive rate by arm and task
mean final task_score over valid attempts
full win rate (won == true and task_score == 1.0)
paired product-grounded minus compact score delta by task and seed
diagnostic_metrics: valid action rate and parser/fallback invalid rate
buy-now transition rate and first-buy step
unique product IDs selected per episode

budget.gpu_uuid_policy: only explicit idle authorized UUIDs; occupied UUID blocks that cell

tracking.offline_fallback: only after exact online initialization/upload failure; preserve error and spool hash

storage_contract.wandb_and_tmp: under per-cell output root via startup_gate_5090.sh

stop_rule: Stop after exactly 32 formal attempts; no prompt wording, horizon, seed, task, or parser sweep after launch.
positive_branch: If product-grounded selectively improves score or full wins across at least two of four task identities with valid paired coverage, register one independent task/seed confirmation; this interface diagnostic alone does not open Q3.
negative_branch: If no selective paired improvement, classify product identity/price grounding as insufficient and stop interface micro-variants; revisit model capability or a separately preregistered experience-content question.
invalid_branch: Exclude operational/parser/identity failures from scientific denominator, preserve them separately, repair only runtime contract, and do not change the frozen comparison.

upstream_audit.decision: retain pinned runtime; active upstream work is unrelated to this frozen WebShop interface diagnostic

claim_boundary: BASE interface diagnostic only. No OpenEvo efficacy, Q3, H2, D0, retention, transfer, or SEED claim.
